defmodule ImagePipeline.RateLimiter do
  use GenServer

  @max_tokens 100
  @refill_interval 1000
  @refill_amount 10

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    schedule_refill()
    {:ok, %{tokens: @max_tokens, waiters: :queue.new()}}
  end

  def acquire(count \\ 1) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:acquire, count}, 30_000)
  end

  def handle_call({:acquire, count}, from, %{tokens: tokens} = state) when tokens >= count do
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | tokens: tokens - count}}
  end

  def handle_call({:acquire, count}, from, state) do
    waiters = :queue.in({from, count}, state.waiters)
    {:noreply, %{state | waiters: waiters}}
  end

  def handle_info(:refill, state) do
    new_tokens = min(state.tokens + @refill_amount, @max_tokens)
    new_state = process_waiters(%{state | tokens: new_tokens})
    schedule_refill()
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  defp process_waiters(state) do
    case :queue.out(state.waiters) do
      {{:value, {from, count}}, rest} when state.tokens >= count ->
        GenServer.reply(from, :ok)
        process_waiters(%{state | tokens: state.tokens - count, waiters: rest})
      _ ->
        state
    end
  end

  defp schedule_refill, do: Process.send_after(self(), :refill, @refill_interval)
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.RetryWorker do
  @max_retries 5
  @base_delay 100

  def with_retry(fun, opts \\ []) do
    max_retries = Keyword.get(opts, :max_retries, @max_retries)
    do_retry(fun, 0, max_retries, [])
  end

  defp do_retry(_fun, attempt, max_retries, errors) when attempt > max_retries do
    {:error, {:max_retries_exceeded, Enum.reverse(errors)}}
  end

  defp do_retry(fun, attempt, max_retries, errors) do
    case fun.() do
      {:ok, result} -> {:ok, result}
      {:error, reason} ->
        delay = calculate_backoff(attempt)
        Process.sleep(delay)
        do_retry(fun, attempt + 1, max_retries, [reason | errors])
    end
  end

  defp calculate_backoff(attempt) do
    jitter = :rand.uniform(50)
    trunc(@base_delay * :math.pow(2, attempt)) + jitter
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.Processor do
  @moduledoc """
  Image processing pipeline with stack-based recursive transformation.
  Processes image tiles recursively with configurable depth.
  """

  @max_dimension 65536
  @tile_size 256
  @stack_guard_pages 2

  defstruct [:data, :width, :height, :depth, :metadata]

  def process_image(image_binary, opts \\ []) do
    with :ok <- ImagePipeline.RateLimiter.acquire(compute_cost(image_binary)),
         {:ok, image} <- decode_image(image_binary, opts) do
      ImagePipeline.RetryWorker.with_retry(fn ->
        transform_recursive(image, opts)
      end)
    end
  end

  defp decode_image(binary, opts) do
    width = Keyword.get(opts, :width, 1024)
    height = Keyword.get(opts, :height, 1024)
    depth = Keyword.get(opts, :depth, 8)

    cond do
      width > @max_dimension or height > @max_dimension ->
        {:error, :dimensions_too_large}
      width <= 0 or height <= 0 ->
        {:error, :invalid_dimensions}
      true ->
        {:ok, %__MODULE__{data: binary, width: width, height: height, depth: depth, metadata: %{}}}
    end
  end

  defp compute_cost(binary) do
    max(1, div(byte_size(binary), 1024))
  end

  defp transform_recursive(image, opts) do
    recursion_limit = Keyword.get(opts, :recursion_limit, compute_safe_depth(image))
    tile_subdivisions = Keyword.get(opts, :subdivisions, 4)

    case apply_tiled_transform(image, 0, recursion_limit, tile_subdivisions) do
      {:ok, _} = result -> result
      {:error, _} = error -> error
    end
  end

  defp compute_safe_depth(image) do
    # Calculate maximum safe recursion depth based on image dimensions
    # Each level subdivides, so depth is log_subdivisions(pixels/tile_size)
    pixels = image.width * image.height
    raw_depth = :math.log(pixels / @tile_size) / :math.log(4)
    # Stack guard: allow depth proportional to available stack
    # BUG: uses signed integer arithmetic - when raw_depth is large,
    # trunc can produce values that bypass the guard page check
    guard_adjusted = trunc(raw_depth) - @stack_guard_pages
    max(guard_adjusted, 1)
  end

  defp apply_tiled_transform(image, current_depth, max_depth, subdivisions) do
    if current_depth >= max_depth do
      {:ok, apply_leaf_transform(image)}
    else
      tiles = subdivide_image(image, subdivisions)
      # Recursive descent into each tile - each call adds to the call stack
      # With subdivisions=4 and unbounded depth, this creates 4^depth frames
      results = Enum.map(tiles, fn tile ->
        # Allocate per-tile processing buffer on stack via binary comprehension
        processing_buffer = create_processing_context(tile, current_depth)
        apply_tiled_transform(
          %{tile | metadata: Map.put(tile.metadata, :buffer, processing_buffer)},
          current_depth + 1,
          max_depth,
          subdivisions
        )
      end)

      case Enum.find(results, &match?({:error, _}, &1)) do
        nil -> {:ok, merge_tiles(results)}
        error -> error
      end
    end
  end

  defp create_processing_context(tile, depth) do
    # Creates a large binary context per recursion level
    # This accumulates on the process heap/stack proportional to depth
    context_size = tile.width * tile.height * tile.depth
    <<0::size(context_size)-unit(8)>>
  end

  defp subdivide_image(image, subdivisions) do
    sub_width = div(image.width, 2)
    sub_height = div(image.height, 2)
    for _i <- 1..subdivisions do
      %__MODULE__{
        data: image.data,
        width: sub_width,
        height: sub_height,
        depth: image.depth,
        metadata: image.metadata
      }
    end
  end

  defp apply_leaf_transform(image) do
    %{image | metadata: Map.put(image.metadata, :processed, true)}
  end

  defp merge_tiles(results) do
    results
    |> Enum.map(fn {:ok, img} -> img end)
    |> List.first()
  end
end
